name: DSPy RLM with tools= (PythonInterpreter: Pyodide on Deno)
pinned: dspy 3.5.0 from PyPI = stanfordnlp/dspy tag 3.5.0 = 4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404 (clone at research/impls/dspy-rlm/src; diff -r against the installed package differs only in __metadata__.py's version stamp and one .code-workspace file). Runtime: Pyodide 0.29.4 (npm, pinned in runner.js:3), Deno 2.9.8 (host install, found on PATH), CPython 3.12. DSPY_CACHEDIR and DENO_DIR pointed into research/impls/dspy-rlm/.
engine: Pyodide 0.29.4 (CPython in WebAssembly) inside a `deno run` subprocess with only --allow-read for the runner file and Deno's cache (cache read revoked after start-up); no --allow-net, --allow-env, --allow-write or --allow-run by default. JSON-RPC over the subprocess's stdin/stdout.
how_run: dspy.RLM('question -> answer', tools=[lookup]) with the default interpreter_factory=PythonInterpreter, driven by dspy.utils.DummyLM returning a scripted {plan, code} action per iteration (probe code, then SUBMIT). One probe execution = one rlm(question=...) forward. What the model sees is read from the next LM request (the chat message after the assistant turn that held the code). No LLM, no API key.

defaults.time: None. PythonInterpreter has no timeout option and blocks on readline() until Deno answers (research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py:677-688 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py#L677-L688); execute loop research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py:862-946 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py#L862-L946)). RLM's max_iters=20 bounds iterations, not time. Observed P6: no-limit-within-120s.
defaults.memory: No DSPy option. The only ceiling is wasm32's 4 GiB address space (Pyodide's memory maximum is 65,536 pages, research/impls/dspy-rlm/deno-cache/npm/registry.npmjs.org/pyodide/0.29.4/pyodide.asm.js). Observed P7: MemoryError after 3.0 s at 2.5 GB peak host tree RSS; host alive, and the same interpreter ran the next iteration (out/P7next.txt).
defaults.output: max_output_chars=10,000 per REPL entry, head 5,000 + tail 5,000 with '... (N characters omitted) ...' (research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/predict/rlm.py:327 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/predict/rlm.py#L327); research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/primitives/repl_types.py:156-164 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/primitives/repl_types.py#L156-L164)). The sandbox returns the last expression's value if it is not None, else captured stdout, never both (research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/primitives/runner.js:495-499 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/primitives/runner.js#L495-L499)).
defaults.tool_calls: No cap on user tool calls. max_llm_calls=50 caps llm_query/llm_query_batched and sandbox sub-agent LM calls per forward (research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/predict/rlm.py:326 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/predict/rlm.py#L326)). Tool calls are serial: each blocks the guest in pyodide.ffi.run_sync and the host handles one at a time (research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/primitives/runner.js:59-60 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/primitives/runner.js#L59-L60); research/impls/dspy-rlm/src/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py:612-616 (https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/4e9db7a83e71e4c36315a2402ae7ffd0c6493404/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py#L612-L616)).
defaults.hardened: hardened is null: the default PythonInterpreter already has every permission off (no read beyond its runtime files, no write, env, net or run), and neither PythonInterpreter nor RLM exposes a time or memory option (python_interpreter.py:233-246, rlm.py:322-333). The only interpreter with a timeout, LocalInterpreter(execution_timeout=...), is documented as not a sandbox (docs/docs/api/tools/LocalInterpreter.md:16-19), so it is looser, not stricter.

source_notes.finding: User tools are normalized to dspy.Tool; the action prompt lists each as `name(arg: type)` - description. Inside the sandbox each tool is a generated synchronous Python def with the tool's parameter names and types, whose body JSON-encodes the kwargs and calls the JS bridge through pyodide.ffi.run_sync.
All tools upfront: every tool signature and description is formatted into the action instructions at construction. No search or lazy loading.

Guest code -> run_sync(JS toolCallBridge) -> a JSON-RPC 'tool_call' line on Deno's stdout -> the host's execute() loop calls the Python tool in the host process and writes the result back on stdin -> the bridge returns it as JSON. One stdin reader and a synchronous host loop make tool calls strictly serial (P9 1,051 ms for five 200 ms calls). Tools, LM credentials and host files stay on the host: the in-sandbox dspy facade sends LM calls to a host SandboxLM that keeps credentials on the wrapped LM and refuses host-file media.

Two layers: Pyodide's virtual filesystem (open('/etc/hosts') -> FileNotFoundError, os.environ empty) and Deno's permission system. Pyodide's `js` module reaches the Deno global, so Deno permissions are the real boundary: js.Deno.readTextFileSync, Deno.env.get, Deno.Command and fetch all raise NotCapable. The Deno process itself inherits the full host environment (deno_subprocess_env copies os.environ), so secrets are one --allow-env flag away. Docs claim 'no filesystem or network access'; probes agree.

The REPL entry the model sees holds the last expression's value when it is not None, otherwise captured stdout; printed text is discarded when the code ends in an expression (P2: only 'RETURNED', none of the 200,000 A's). Each entry is cut to max_output_chars=10,000 as head+tail with an '(N characters omitted)' marker (Pcap).

No time limit and no memory option anywhere in PythonInterpreter or RLM; the RLM knobs are max_iters, max_llm_calls and max_output_chars. LocalInterpreter has execution_timeout, but its docs say it is not a security sandbox, so it is not a hardened option.

One interpreter per forward(): variables persist across REPL iterations of one RLM call and start fresh in the next call. Start-up restores a DSPy-built Pyodide memory snapshot from $DSPY_CACHEDIR/sandbox.

A Python exception reaches the model as '[Error] <Type>: <args list>' (P10: "[Error] ValueError: ['probe-boom']"): no traceback, no line number. A JS-side failure that ends the Deno process (uncaught network or Deno-permission errors, os.system) raises CodeInterpreterError out of rlm(); RLM only catches CodeExecutionError and SyntaxError, so the whole forward fails and the model never sees an error.

llm_query / llm_query_batched and in-sandbox dspy sub-agents (Predict, ReAct, nested RLM) are bridged to the host LM. Deno is found on PATH unless the dspy[deno] extra is installed; versions 2.x only. The sandbox cache is written under $DSPY_CACHEDIR (default ~/.dspy_cache) unless DSPY_SANDBOX_CACHE=0.

surprises: Printed output is silently dropped whenever the code's last statement is an expression with a non-None value: runner.js returns the value instead of stdout (runner.js:499). The RLM prompt tells the model to 'ALWAYS print to see results' (rlm.py:83), so a natural trailing expression hides everything it printed. Evidence out/P2.txt (0 of 200,000 A's returned) and out/P2both.txt.

Several blocked operations kill the sandbox instead of raising inside it: an uncaught urllib error (P3), an uncaught js.Deno permission error (P12js), and os.system (P12b, 'Pyodide has suffered a fatal error ... NotCapable: Requires env access'). Deno exits, rlm() raises CodeInterpreterError to the caller, and the run is lost. The same calls inside try/except raise catchable errors (out/P3try.txt, out/P12jsTry.txt).
No time limit at all: P6 ran past 120 s and there is no option for one in PythonInterpreter or RLM, so a single `while True: pass` hangs the forward indefinitely.
Error text keeps the message but loses the traceback and line number, and shows exception args as a Python list ("ValueError: ['probe-boom']").

The Deno subprocess receives the whole host environment; only the absence of --allow-env keeps it from guest code (P12jsTry A1: NotCapable for PROBE_SECRET). A user who passes enable_env_vars for one variable grants exactly that one, which is correct, but the secret values are present in the sandbox process's own memory.
Pyodide's subclasses walk works (P12a: 1,122 classes, Popen and _wrap_close present), but they are the WASM interpreter's, not the host's: os.popen fails with 'emscripten does not support processes.'

P2.detail: The model saw '<repl_output>\nRETURNED\n</repl_output>': the last expression's value replaced stdout entirely, so none of the 200,000 printed A's came back and there is no marker (runner.js:499). Print-only output is capped at 10,000 with a marker (Pcap).

P2both.detail: print('PRINTED') then 'RETURNED': the model saw only RETURNED.

Pcap.detail: print('B' * 30000): the model saw 9,999 B's (head 5,000 + tail 5,000 incl. newline) around '... (20,001 characters omitted) ...'.

P3.detail: Both SPEC forms killed the interpreter: 'CodeInterpreterError: Deno exited (code 0) during execution: (last sandbox diagnostic: Unhandled async error: PythonError)', raised out of rlm(). Wrapped in try/except (P3try): urllib -> URLError <urlopen error [Errno 23] Host is unreachable>; pyodide.http.pyfetch -> 'Requires net access to "example.com:443", run again with the --allow-net flag'; js.fetch -> NotCapable (P12jsTry).

P4.detail: '[Error] FileNotFoundError: [44, \'No such file or directory\']' (Pyodide's in-memory FS has no /etc/hosts); js.Deno.readTextFileSync('/etc/hosts') -> 'NotCapable: Requires read access to "/etc/hosts"' (P12jsTry).

P5.detail: os.environ.get('PROBE_SECRET') -> None inside Pyodide; js.Deno.env.get('PROBE_SECRET') -> 'NotCapable: Requires env access to "PROBE_SECRET"' (P12jsTry). The Deno process does hold the host env.

P7next.detail: In one forward: the memory loop caught MemoryError, then the next iteration printed 'next iteration 2'. Peak tree RSS 3.0 GB.

P8.detail: Two iterations of one forward: the second printed 7 (P8within). Two separate forwards: the second printed 'gone'.

P8within.detail: Second iteration of the same forward printed 7.

P11.detail: 20 fresh RLM forwards (new Deno + Pyodide each, plus DummyLM and the SUBMIT turn): median 466.9 ms, p90 528.7 ms. p11_breakdown.txt, taken under heavier machine load: 1,258 ms per 1-iteration forward and ~69 ms per extra iteration in a warm interpreter.

P12js.detail: Uncaught, each of js.Deno.readTextFileSync, Deno.env.get, Deno.Command and fetch ended the Deno process (CodeInterpreterError 'Deno exited (code 0)'). Deno.permissions.querySync for /etc/hosts reports 'prompt' (not granted; no TTY to prompt).

P12jsTry.detail: read /etc/hosts, env PROBE_SECRET, run echo, net example.com:443: each raised JsException NotCapable 'Requires ... access ..., run again with the --allow-... flag'.

P3try.detail: urllib -> URLError Host is unreachable; pyfetch -> AbortError Requires net access to example.com:443.
